name: Batman
hook: Gotham's caped crusader, from the Batusi to the Dark Knight Returns.

facts.label: Gotham City
facts.statement: Gotham City is Batman's home, just as Metropolis is Superman's.

facts.label: Adam West
facts.statement: Adam West played Batman on the 1960s TV series and popularized the Batusi dance.

facts.label: Michael Keaton
facts.statement: Michael Keaton played Batman in Tim Burton's 1989 film; his birth name was Michael Douglas.

facts.label: Christian Bale
facts.statement: Welsh-born Christian Bale played Batman in Batman Begins after dropping 63 pounds for The Machinist.

facts.label: Catwoman
facts.statement: Julie Newmar played Catwoman on the 1960s TV series, and Lesley Gore's Pussycat was her sidekick in two 1967 episodes.

facts.label: Alfred
facts.statement: Alfred is the Wayne family butler, played on film by Michael Caine, Jeremy Irons and Andy Serkis.

facts.label: Frank Miller
facts.statement: Frank Miller wrote Batman: The Dark Knight Returns, the miniseries that remade Batman as a grim vigilante.
